scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 31 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 46 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

road-grand-tour-of-switzerland-part-1.story: From Zürich it runs 453 km to Samedan; allow about 6 h 37 of riding. It goes by way of Schaffhausen, Bodensee, St. Gallen and Appenzell. The highest point is about 2,450 m. Fluela Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It crosses from Switzerland into Liechtenstein - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Transfagarasan Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 79 km this is Transfagarasan Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-olteni-castelul-miko-radacinesti-.story: 401 km from Bodoc to Bodoc, about 6 h 55 of riding. On the way it passes Village of Prejmer-Tartlau, Râșnov - Cumidava / La Cetate, Rucăr - Scărișoara and Rădăcinești - Cetate. The highest point is about 1,300 m. The line favours views over speed.
